import hashlib
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import traceback
import uuid
from time import monotonic

from complete_main_onboarding_native import observation

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tests/integration'))
import hidden_desktop

source = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
output = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
if not hidden_desktop.is_child(output):
    assert not (output / 'result.json').exists(), 'Use a fresh output directory'
    hidden_desktop.DESKTOP = f'FrontEngineColdReload{os.getpid()}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}'
    before = observation()
    manifest = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                for p in (ROOT / 'frontengine').rglob('*.py')}
    (output / 'source-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))
    shutil.copy2(__file__, output / 'harness.py')
    code = hidden_desktop.run_on_hidden_desktop(__file__, str(source), str(output), timeout_ms=480000)
    unchanged = all(hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
                    for name, digest in manifest.items())
    (output / 'observer.json').write_text(json.dumps({'before': before, 'after': observation(),
        'child_exit': code, 'source_unchanged': unchanged, 'observation_only': True}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    raise SystemExit(code)

os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM'] = 'windows'
expected = json.loads((source / 'shutdown-world.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
result = {'passed': False}
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fe-current-cold-reload-') as folder:
        shutil.copytree(source / 'settings', folder, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        previous = Path.cwd()
        os.chdir(folder)
        try:
            from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent, Qt
            from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
            from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
            from frontengine.ui.page.pet_game import home_page
            from frontengine.utils.session_lock import session_lock
            from frontengine.user_setting.user_setting_file import user_setting_dict
            from frontengine.utils.pet_game import snapshot

            home_page.workshop_pack_roots = lambda: []
            session_lock.is_session_locked = lambda: False
            app = QApplication([])
            app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
            from frontengine.ui import main_ui
            main_ui.CriticalExit.init_critical_exit = lambda self: None
            main_ui.HotkeyService.start = lambda self: False
            main_ui.AppProfileService.start = lambda self: None
            main_ui.ShareWatchService.start = lambda self: None
            window = main_ui.FrontEngineMainUI(show_system_tray_ray=False, redirect_output=False)
            lifetime = window.lifetime
            page = window.pet_home_ui
            try:
                actual = snapshot.to_dict(page.service.world)
                assert actual == expected, 'Cold process world differs from final shutdown snapshot'
                residents = set(page.service.world.residents)
                records = user_setting_dict['pet_profiles']['records']
                assert residents <= set(records), 'Resident profiles missing from settings'
                assert residents == set(page.service.sessions), 'Resident identity leases were not reacquired'
                result.update(world_snapshot_equal=True, resident_profiles_persisted=True,
                    leases_reacquired=True, residents=sorted(residents), ledger_coins=page.service.world.ledger.coins)
                from frontengine.utils.pet_game.world import COMMANDS
                world = page.service.world
                window.resize(1280, 960)
                window.show()
                page.tabs.setCurrentIndex(page.tabs.keys().index('pet_home_residents_section'))
                page.residents.list.setCurrentRow(0)
                resident_id = page.residents.list.currentItem().data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                resident = world.residents[resident_id]
                initial_energy = resident.needs['energy']
                initial_x = resident.x_milli
                events = []
                started = monotonic()
                page.service.events_ready.connect(lambda batch: events.extend(dict(event) for event in batch))
                if not page.service.running:
                    page.run_button.click()
                button = page.residents.commands[COMMANDS.index('sleep')]
                page._scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(button)
                app.processEvents()
                assert button.isEnabled() and not button.visibleRegion().isEmpty()
                button.click()
                states = {}
                play_sent = False
                bed_id = None
                start_world = world.time_ms
                while monotonic() - started < 300:
                    QTest.qWait(100)
                    activity = resident.activity
                    elapsed = monotonic() - started
                    if activity and activity.kind == 'sleep':
                        bed_id = activity.furniture
                        assert bed_id is not None
                        assert world.furniture[bed_id].users.get(activity.point) == resident_id
                        caption = page.residents.activity.text()
                        assert 'sleep' in caption.casefold(), caption
                        state = activity.phase
                        if state == 'using':
                            assert resident.x_milli == activity.target_x
                        if state not in states:
                            states[state] = {'elapsed_s': elapsed, 'energy': resident.needs['energy'],
                                             'x': resident.x_milli, 'target_x': activity.target_x,
                                             'caption': caption, 'bed': bed_id}
                            assert window.grab().save(str(output / (state + '.png')))
                    completed = any(event.get('kind') == 'completed' and event.get('activity') == 'sleep'
                                    and event.get('resident') == resident_id for event in events)
                    if completed and not play_sent:
                        assert 'moving' in states and 'using' in states
                        assert resident.needs['energy'] >= 95 > initial_energy
                        assert resident_id not in world.furniture[bed_id].users.values()
                        states['completed'] = {'elapsed_s': elapsed, 'energy': resident.needs['energy'],
                                               'caption': page.residents.activity.text()}
                        assert window.grab().save(str(output / 'completed.png'))
                        page.residents.commands[COMMANDS.index('play')].click()
                        play_sent = True
                    if play_sent and activity and activity.kind == 'play' and activity.phase == 'using':
                        assert resident.x_milli != states['using']['x']
                        assert resident_id not in world.furniture[bed_id].users.values()
                        states['left_bed'] = {'elapsed_s': elapsed, 'x': resident.x_milli,
                                             'caption': page.residents.activity.text()}
                        assert window.grab().save(str(output / 'left-bed.png'))
                        break
                    (output / 'heartbeat.json').write_text(json.dumps({'elapsed_s': elapsed,
                        'energy': resident.needs['energy'], 'states': states}), encoding='utf-8')
                assert 'left_bed' in states, states
                active_elapsed = monotonic() - started
                assert 0.95 * active_elapsed <= (world.time_ms - start_world) / 1000 <= active_elapsed + 2
                result.update(rest_lifecycle=states, initial_energy=initial_energy, initial_x=initial_x,
                              elapsed_s=active_elapsed, events=events, realtime_verified=True,
                              command_scope='Sleep then play via resident-card buttons; no simulation or need injection')
                assert page.service.save_now()
                (output / 'final-world.json').write_text(json.dumps(snapshot.to_dict(world), indent=2))
            finally:
                window.request_shutdown()
                deadline = monotonic() + 120
                while not lifetime.closed and monotonic() < deadline:
                    QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
                    app.processEvents()
                    QTest.qWait(10)
                assert lifetime.closed, (lifetime.state, lifetime.error)
            result.update(passed=True, runtime_closed=True, python=sys.version,
                source=str(source), saved_snapshot_sha256=hashlib.sha256((source / 'shutdown-world.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                scope='Normal-speed sleep/use/release/play path in full MainUI on private desktop using prior real gameplay save; global hotkey/emergency/app-profile/share-watch starts, Workshop discovery and session-lock query substituted')
        finally:
            logging.shutdown()
            os.chdir(previous)
    result['temporary_directory_removed'] = True
except Exception:
    result.update(passed=False, error=traceback.format_exc())
(output / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
raise SystemExit(0 if result['passed'] else 1)

    raise SystemExit(code)

result = {'passed': False}
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fe-current-cold-reload-') as folder:
        shutil.copytree(source / 'settings', folder, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        previous = Path.cwd()
        os.chdir(folder)
        try:
            from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent, QPoint, Qt
            from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
            from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
            from frontengine.ui.page.pet_game import home_page
            from frontengine.utils.session_lock import session_lock
            from frontengine.user_setting.user_setting_file import user_setting_dict
            from frontengine.utils.pet_game import snapshot

            home_page.workshop_pack_roots = lambda: []
            session_lock.is_session_locked = lambda: False
            app = QApplication([])
            app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
            from frontengine.ui import main_ui
            main_ui.CriticalExit.init_critical_exit = lambda self: None
            main_ui.HotkeyService.start = lambda self: False
            main_ui.AppProfileService.start = lambda self: None
            main_ui.ShareWatchService.start = lambda self: None
            window = main_ui.FrontEngineMainUI(show_system_tray_ray=False, redirect_output=False)
            lifetime = window.lifetime
            page = window.pet_home_ui
            try:
                actual = snapshot.to_dict(page.service.world)
                assert actual == expected, 'Cold process world differs from final shutdown snapshot'
                residents = set(page.service.world.residents)
                records = user_setting_dict['pet_profiles']['records']
                assert residents <= set(records), 'Resident profiles missing from settings'
                assert residents == set(page.service.sessions), 'Resident identity leases were not reacquired'
                from frontengine.utils.pet_game.world import COMMANDS
                window.resize(1280, 960)
                window.show()
                page.tabs.setCurrentIndex(page.tabs.keys().index('pet_home_residents_section'))
                page.residents.list.setCurrentRow(0)
                QTest.qWait(1000)
                button = page.residents.commands[COMMANDS.index('sleep')]
                bar = page._scroll.verticalScrollBar()
                samples = []
                def sample(label):
                    focus = app.focusWidget()
                    samples.append({'label': label, 'scroll': bar.value(), 'maximum': bar.maximum(),
                                    'button_visible': not button.visibleRegion().isEmpty(),
                                    'card_visible': not page.residents.activity.visibleRegion().isEmpty(),
                                    'button_y': button.mapTo(page._scroll.viewport(), QPoint()).y(),
                                    'card_y': page.residents.activity.mapTo(page._scroll.viewport(), QPoint()).y(),
                                    'caption': page.residents.activity.text(),
                                    'focus': type(focus).__name__ if focus else None})
                sample('settled_initial')
                for mode in ('button_click', 'qt_mouse_click'):
                    page._scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(button)
                    QTest.qWait(200)
                    sample(mode + '_before')
                    assert button.isEnabled() and not button.visibleRegion().isEmpty()
                    if mode == 'button_click':
                        button.click()
                    else:
                        QTest.mouseClick(button, Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton)
                    sample(mode + '_immediate')
                    QTest.qWait(1000)
                    sample(mode + '_after_1s')
                    assert window.grab().save(str(output / (mode + '.png')))
                page._scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(page.residents.activity)
                QTest.qWait(300)
                sample('card_explicitly_scrolled')
                assert window.grab().save(str(output / 'resident-card.png'))
                result['scroll_samples'] = samples
                result.update(world_snapshot_equal=True, resident_profiles_persisted=True,
                    leases_reacquired=True, residents=sorted(residents), ledger_coins=page.service.world.ledger.coins)
            finally:
                window.request_shutdown()
                deadline = monotonic() + 120
                while not lifetime.closed and monotonic() < deadline:
                    QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
                    app.processEvents()
                    QTest.qWait(10)
                assert lifetime.closed, (lifetime.state, lifetime.error)
            result.update(passed=True, runtime_closed=True, python=sys.version,
                source=str(source), saved_snapshot_sha256=hashlib.sha256((source / 'shutdown-world.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                scope='Fresh full MainUI native process on private desktop; copied captured settings; global hotkey/emergency/app-profile/share-watch starts, Workshop discovery and session-lock query substituted')
        finally:
            logging.shutdown()
            os.chdir(previous)
    result['temporary_directory_removed'] = True

    result.update(passed=False, error=traceback.format_exc())

raise SystemExit(0 if result['passed'] else 1)
